items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know her but just her singing.

ctx.x: And one before that with Helen Merrill that he did.

Oh yeah, Helen Merrill I was in love with, not – I didn’t know her but just her singing. That’s another singer I used to love. Her, Jeri Southern, you know the kind of singer, Julie London in her day, I like those kind of singers, the understated ones.
That’s a dying art it would seem.
